what: A fifth grounding check: a quotation must appear in the document it is attributed to
set: evals/golden-rules/rules.yaml plus the refusal half of all four other sets; and 674 archived answers
model: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 Q4_K_M, llama.cpp, n_ctx 8192, 4 CPU threads; BM25 only

the_hole.shipped_in: v0.12.10, which named it as the largest open one
the_hole.answer: Asked who approves a contract of exactly EUR 25,000, the model said Head of Department - correct - and supported it with "Contract value (annual): Above EUR 25,000 | Approver: Chief Financial Officer | Additional requirement: Three competitive quotes", in the table's own column format and inside quotation marks.
the_hole.why_it_is_false: No such row exists. 'Above EUR 25,000' is in section 2 as prose about competitive quotes and is never paired with an approver; the answer welded it to the CFO row.
the_hole.why_the_gate_could_not_see_it: Checks 3 and 4 are number membership and word overlap. Every element of the fabricated row is real somewhere in the document, so a sentence assembled from the corpus's own vocabulary is grounded by construction. The same blindness passed an invented fourth act of a three-act play at 96% support in v0.12.8.
the_hole.the_shape_of_it: A false attribution rather than a false fact: the invented row is semantically true and the conclusion drawn from it is correct.

measured_before_building.method: every answer this repository kept from its own evaluation runs, each paired with the documents that answer cited

normalisation_ladder.table_separators_and_dashes_folded: 0 more - the loosest rung considered recovered nothing and is not shipped

genuine_fabrications: 'The per diem allowance covers meals, including taxes and tips' (10 words) - a paraphrase in quotation marks; ftr-300-1 says the allowance is 'a daily payment instead of reimbursement for actual expenses for lodging, meals, and related incidental expenses'
honest_spans_a_naive_check_would_reject: 'from X to Y' (4 words) - a schematic placeholder: 'both documents use "from X to Y" bands'
'equal to or above' (4 words, twice) - quoted IN ORDER TO DENY IT: 'the policy specifies "above EUR 25,000" and not "equal to or above"'
and_then_the_five_were_read_rather_than_.so_the_naive_check_would_be: 40% precise - three honest answers rejected for two fabrications. That is the risk v0.12.10 named, turned into a number.

the_floor_was_swept_not_guessed.5_to_10: 2 rejections, 2 genuine - a plateau, not a point
the_floor_was_swept_not_guessed.chosen: 8, the middle of the plateau. Both false positives are 4 words; both fabrications 10 and 17.
the_floor_was_swept_not_guessed.and_a_reason_behind_it: a four-word quoted fragment mentions a phrase; a longer span claims what a document says.

the_change.rule: A span in quotation marks of 8+ words must appear in the cited text, after collapsing whitespace and dropping Markdown emphasis and case.
the_change.checked_against: the raw cited text, not the machine-talk-filtered evidence - 'does this document contain these words' is a question about the document as written; whether those words prove anything is what the support ratio is for. Passage headers count, being text the model was shown.
the_change.denial_exemption: a span quoted inside a negation is exempt at any length. The floor already excludes both denials in the sample, at four words each; this covers the longer one the sample did not happen to contain.
the_change.the_asker_is_not_a_source: The first version admitted the QUESTION as quotable text, by analogy with the figure check admitting the asker's numbers. The analogy is wrong. A number in the question must be repeatable or 'is EUR 40,000 above the limit?' cannot be answered - and even there it is admitted only beside a figure from the sources, because attacking that fix showed a leading question could otherwise write a number into policy. Quoted prose has no such need and the identical hole: it would let `Does the policy say "all contracts require three quotes regardless of value"?` legitimise its own answer. Removed, and pinned by a test.

registered_before_the_arm.prediction: This costs a passing case. The fabricated row is in rule-08's answer, which passes today, so golden-rules falls from 71.4% to 64.3%.
registered_before_the_arm.why_that_is_the_point: An answer whose citation is invented should not be served, and a gate that only ever fired on wrong answers would not be a gate.

result.only_one_case_moved: rule-08, from answered to refused. The other thirteen are unchanged.
result.historical_sample: the shipped rule, imported by the measurement tool rather than reimplemented, rejects exactly 2 of the 99 spans - both fabrications, neither honest span.

the_determinism_drop_is_the_finding.numbers: 100% -> 93.8%, and it is not a regression
the_determinism_drop_is_the_finding.so: In the old arm the second ask never reached the model: the fabricated answer had been cached, and every later ask replayed it verbatim. Determinism read 100% because the fabrication was frozen and re-served. Refusals are never cached, so once the gate rejects the first answer the second ask really does call the model, and the model's second answer differed.
the_determinism_drop_is_the_finding.the_uncomfortable_part: Caching a fabricated citation makes it look perfectly deterministic. The metric was measuring the cache, not the model.
the_determinism_drop_is_the_finding.what_this_does_not_establish: How often the model fabricates here. Two generations is not a rate, and the second one passed.

sabotages: check removed entirely (v0.12.10 behaviour) - 3 tests fail
floor lowered to 4 words, the naive check - fails
question re-admitted as quotable text - fails

still_failing_and_untouched.rule-07: reaches the right conclusion and opens with the wrong one
still_failing_and_untouched.rule-05: refuses a question the corpus covers
still_failing_and_untouched.rule-03: exam defect: must_cite too narrow, both documents state the same bands
still_failing_and_untouched.rule-06: exam defect: the corpus genuinely disagrees - 500, 1,000, and a superseded 300

what_this_cannot_establish: Two fabrications is a small sample of the thing being caught, both from one model on two corpora. The 94 spans the check must NOT disturb are the stronger half of the evidence. A frontier model quoting across a hundred corpora could produce a form of faithful quotation this ladder has never seen; the honest response then is another rung with its own measurement, not a loosened floor.
